definitions: Undertakings for the Collective Investment in Transferable Securities. A regulatory framework in the European Union that allows for the sale of harmonized collective investment schemes across EU member states.
A type of investment fund that complies with theUCITS directive, making it eligible for sale to retail investors across the EU.
examples: Many investors prefer UCITS funds due to their regulatory oversight.
The new UCITS directive aims to enhance investor protection.
Our portfolio includes several UCITS-compliant ETFs.
